method.description: Three coherent in-memory layouts were screened with native KiCad pad geometry, full-span through-via annuli, fixed copper, drill and corrected 0.25 mm rear-contact clearance. Moved signal and supply pads were provisionally reconnected to their existing local terminals; both IMU ground returns and a bent local INT exit were reserved simultaneously.

attempts.retry_1: Moved the proposed lower GND return away from fixed +3V3 via 6421709a-0a8e-5ae6-b17a-69e9ccb61078, separated the proposed +3V3 transition from the INT corridor, and removed meaningless NC-pad tails.
attempts.retry_2: Retained the existing +3V3 transition at 87.9,93.6 after the eastern replacement site entered the rear-contact exclusion; moved GND67 into space opened by IC4 and placed GND123 between the two known fixed +3V3 vias.

required_joint_duties: Preserve +3V3 service to IC4.5, IC4.8 and IC4.12 with C23/C24 local decoupling and the R14.1 pullup feed.
Preserve SCL from IC4.13 through R14.2 and the existing external continuation.
Preserve SDA from IC4.14 through R15.2 and the existing external continuation.
Preserve /IMU_INT2 from IC4.9 to its existing external path.
Provide a legal local INT exit without claiming the later IC1.34 connection.
Preserve all outside copper, both terminal-cut private returns, CELL_NEG isolation, the In2 +3V3 bridge, C12 feed, USBBOOT route and all 21 zone definitions.

plans.name: P1_IC4_N050
root_blockers: The GND67 ordinary-via annulus at 89.35,93.99 enters the authoritative rear-contact exclusion.

The GND123 via/stub conflicts with protected SCL continuation 3af9f604-730a-57dc-bda2-07d0adec1b60 and fixed +3V3 via 6d56c09b-2b19-5144-a473-6e1c16d7c430 at 91.95,92.10; the four layer hits are one physical through-via obstruction.
Straight moved-pad reconnections create F.Cu +3V3-to-SCL and SCL-to-SDA mutual-clearance conflicts.

plans.name: P2_decaps_open
root_blockers: Moved R15.2 conflicts with protected +3V3 boundary trace 2fe17ed1-3ec0-5d72-87a4-f13f47809ab1.

plans.name: P3_pullups_split
root_blockers: Moved IC4.1 conflicts with fixed +3V3 via 6421709a-0a8e-5ae6-b17a-69e9ccb61078 at 90.7,91.65.
Moved R15.2 conflicts with protected +3V3 boundary trace 2fe17ed1-3ec0-5d72-87a4-f13f47809ab1.
The GND123 return remains obstructed by protected SCL continuation 3af9f604-730a-57dc-bda2-07d0adec1b60 and fixed +3V3 via 6d56c09b-2b19-5144-a473-6e1c16d7c430.
Straight moved-pad reconnections create F.Cu +3V3/SCL/SDA mutual-clearance conflicts, and the GND67 stub conflicts with a +3V3 reconnection.

disposition.supported_conclusion: None of the three bounded coherent constructions provides simultaneous legal returns, supply/decoupling, I2C, /IMU_INT2 and INT escape. The result does not prove that every coordinated re-layout is impossible; it proves that these three constructions cannot be promoted without changing held geometry or introducing a materially different local routing topology.
specific_blocking_constraints: The apparent lower-return corridor is bounded by two fixed +3V3 through-vias and the protected SCL continuation.
The space opened near IC4.6/7 projects into the authoritative B-contact exclusion for an ordinary full-span via.
The tested short-tail strategy cannot preserve +3V3, SCL and SDA clearances simultaneously after the component shifts.
The larger P3 IC4 shift directly violates fixed-via clearance before complete routing is considered.
not_authorized_or_not_attempted: No fourth placement plan or coordinate sweep.
No movement of fixed vias 6421709a-0a8e-5ae6-b17a-69e9ccb61078 or 6d56c09b-2b19-5144-a473-6e1c16d7c430.
No change to protected boundary trace 2fe17ed1-3ec0-5d72-87a4-f13f47809ab1 or outside SCL continuation 3af9f604-730a-57dc-bda2-07d0adec1b60.
No reduced clearance, smaller via, blind/microvia, new via-in-pad process, contact-envelope waiver or In1 signal route.

completed: Native moved-pad and through-via all-layer geometry screening.
Fixed copper, drill and rear-contact exclusion screening.
not_run_because_no_plan_passed_prelimina: Candidate serialization and staged-manifest pose update.
All-layer connectivity, floating-copper and preserved-pad-group proof.
Terminal-cut private-return and CELL_NEG isolation proof.
Mechanical-proxy screening and whole-assembly CAD/source rebind.

lessons: The native three-plan screen completed each pass in under the 120 second subprocess limit; grouping a through-via's four layer hits prevents over-counting one physical obstruction.
Checking fixed vias and contact exclusions before topology substitution eliminated invalid return sites before candidate serialization, refill or DRC.

Moved-pad-to-old-terminal tails are a bounded preservation strategy, but their two recurring F.Cu mutual conflicts show that a future authorized attempt needs a jointly synthesized local I2C/supply topology rather than more placement points.
